question: ________ introduced the daroga system, replacing zamindari thanedars under the direct control of the district head and on its payroll.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Cornwallis.**__** **** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lord Cornwallis (1786-1793) introduced the system of Daroga as part of Police reforms. **
 
• **Police of each district was placed under District Judge.**
 
• Each district was divided into Thanas/Police circles which will be **headed by Daroga.**
 
• Charles Cornwallis was a British army officer who served as a general during the Re**volutionary War (also known as the American Revolution)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Minto** I was the 17th Viceroy of India** Grant of separate electorates to Muslims, **was under his reign.
 
• **Warren Hastings** was a British colonial administrator, **first Governor-General of Bengal in 1772–1785.**
 
• **Lord Wellesley** made the first attempt to train Civil Servants locally, he **established Fort Williams College **on the Fort William campus.also was **an Anglo-Irish politician and colonial administrator.**
